articleTitle: A CFO Estimation Method Based on Preamble Symbols for GFDM
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Generalized frequency division multiplexing (GFDM), as a new multi-carrier modulation technology, is proposed to meet the requirements of 5G application scenarios. It overcomes the limitations of OFDM and has many advantages such as low peak-to-average power ratio, low out-of-band radiation, high spectrum utilization rate and flexible data transmission parameter setting. But the same as OFDM, if the carrier frequency offset (CFO) caused by the misalignment of the transmitter and receiver local oscillators cannot be accurately estimated and corrected, it will adversely affect the performance of the GFDM system. Therefore, this paper proposes a lead symbol based on repeat symbols. Based on the correlation between preamble symbols and neutron symbols, the carrier frequency error is estimated by means of mean estimation method. The results show that this method can effectively estimate CFO, and has higher accuracy compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Solutions of 5G RAN on High-Speed Train: Proposed for 5G RAN system equipped directly onto the high-speed train
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: The High-Speed Train (HST) scenario is one of the promising 5G deployment scenarios, which can offer broadband access to passengers on a high-speed train running up to 500 km/h. Such very high mobility as well as the characteristics of 5G Radio Access Network (RAN) brings about considerable technical challenges to be coped with, and the traditional way of mobile operator's wireless signal coverage along the HST will be unsustainable. In this paper, we propose two approaches for 5G RAN system equipped directly onto the high-speed train, rather than the traditional way of outdoor signal penetrating indoors. The advantages as well as disadvantages of the two approaches have been compared and analyzed. In the end of the paper, a solution is proposed for integrating the 5G RAN system equipped directly onto the high-speed train with the original passenger service platform of the HST, to support value-added services.

articleTitle: Interference Suppression of MIMO-OFDM Based Visible Light Communication System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: A novel anti-interference method of visible light communication system is proposed in this paper. Different detection algorithms are used to detect the system performance. The results indicate the proposed scheme provides the system a better bit error rate (BER).

articleTitle: Dual-port Quasi-absorptive Microstrip Bandpass Filters with Excellent All-band Reflectionless
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: A dual-port bandpass filter (BPF) with symmetrical quasi-absorption and excellent all-band reflectionless characteristics is proposed. The quasi-absorptive BPF consists of a bandpass section and two absorptive sections. The bandpass section adopts a first-order coupled microstrip line to transmit spectral energy, and the out-of-band energy is absorbed by two absorptive sections. The absorptive section realizes signal rejection of out-of-band by impedance matching. Adding absorptive sections at both the input and output ends, a symmetrical quasi-absorptive BPF is achieved. The return loss of the input and output has the same characteristics, and the reflection coefficient is lower than the single-port quasi-absorptive BPF. CAD simulation results show that the proposed quasi-absorptive BPF has the excellent all-band reflectionless filtering performance.

articleTitle: Short-range THz Channel Measurement and Analysis About Diffraction in Indoor Propagation Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: This article presents a short-range THz channel measurement result covering 285GHz − 315GHz. We modeled a short-range THz channel path loss based on measurements. The edge diffraction phenomenon is measured and analyzed, and the effect of thin plate structure on the electromagnetic diffraction in the THz band is modeled and analyzed with the path loss model combined. The effect of thin plate obscuration on the line of sight (Los) path of shot-range THz channel is also measured and analyzed, and finally the effect of human hand on the short-range THz channel is measured and studied.

articleTitle: Design of Telemetry Antenna for Multi-Target in Hemispherical Coverage
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: With the increasing number of test aircraft and measurement and control distance in aviation flight test, telemetry monitoring has been put forward higher requirements. In order to further meet the requirements of telemetry and monitoring, an omni-directional multi-target telemetry antenna based on phased array is designed in this paper. The antenna adopts the structure of three plane arrays to realize the telemetry and tracking coverage of four aircraft in the whole airspace. This paper analyzes and simulates the antenna element, antenna array, receiving module and thermal design, and processes and manufactures the principle prototype. Tested in a microwave darkroom, the results show that the antenna gain is not less than 21.02dBi in the range of pitch <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{0^{\circ}\sim 30^{\circ}}$</tex>, and the antenna gain shall not be less than 16.29dBi within the pitch range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{30^{\circ}\sim 90^{\circ}}$</tex>. The antenna has been applied in flight test, which greatly improves the capacity of telemetry system.

articleTitle: A Research on the Authentication Scheme For 5G Network Based on Double Ratchet Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Security threats faced in the 5G network communication is analyzed in this paper. For the 5G network provides high quality communication ability to every aspect of the society, the security situation becomes more challenging for each user in the 5G network. The authentication scheme is the first defending line for the 5G network system. The leakage of shared keys can cause serious security problem and an enhanced scheme for authentication based on double ratchet algorithm is proposed in this paper to ensure the end-to-end communication secrecy. Security analysis shows that the double ratchet algorithm can effectively enhance the communication security of the 5G network authentication method.

articleTitle: Research on Node Selection Algorithm of Near Space Relay Link
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of over the horizon communication of near space vehicles, this paper studies the relay link node selection algorithm. Firstly, the model of satellite cooperative relay system is established, and a relay satellite selection algorithm based on fairness is proposed, which is simulated and compared with polling algorithm and maximum signal-to-noise ratio algorithm. The simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can take into account the fairness between relay nodes and make effective use of relay nodes, and it ensures the maximization of the overall utility of the relay nodes.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Telemetry Antenna Visibility under the Influence of Terrain
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the terrain or buildings will form the blind area of telemetry antenna, this paper designs a visibility analysis method of telemetry antenna and testing aircraft under the influence of terrain, which can simulate and analyze the azimuth / elevation mask of telemetry antenna. Firstly, based on the electromagnetic wave propagation equation, the three-dimensional action range of the antenna under free condition is modeled; Then, the electromagnetic propagation is simulated by geometric optics method; Finally, the visibility of telemetry antenna and testing machine under terrain occlusion is calculated. In this paper, the telemetry link visual simulation software is designed, and the above method is verified by visual means. The results show that this method has high reliability and can provide support for the route planning of the test aircraft in flight test.

articleTitle: KLDLoc: A WiFi Fingerprint-based Localization Method Based on Kullback-Leibler Divergence
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In recent years, with the gradual popularity of wireless local area networks (WLANs) and mobile devices, WiFi fingerprint-based localization technology has won wide attention from researchers by virtue of its simple principle and pervasiveness. This paper discusses one of the key problems in WiFi fingerprint-based localization, namely improving the localization performance with a few samples. To solve this problem, the Kullback-Leibler Divergence(KLD) of two Gaussian distributions is proposed to measure the difference between two fingerprints. From the theoretical analysis, it can be obtained that the proposed one is more robust compared to the mean or variance-based measures. In this paper, we present a Kullback-Leibler Divergence-based solution, termed KLDLoc. Extensive experiments using real-world datasets are conducted and show that in comparison with several existing methods, KLDLoc can improve the localization accuracy by at least 38%.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Signals and Power Transmission over Hybrid RoF and PWoF System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: This paper introduces a 5G network based on the fusion of RoF and PWoF. Wireless signal transmission and electric energy transmission are integrated through optical fiber network. The experimental simulation of the transmission capacity and efficiency of the system shows that the system can provide the power required by the remote antenna unit(RAU) and concentrate the power supply system in the central control system. This paper also builds the basic framework of the fusion system, sorts out the experimental ideas, simulates the system with software, and finally verifies the reliability of the fusion system.

articleTitle: Side Information Improvement Algorithm Based on Denoising Algorithm for Distributed Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Distributed Video Coding (DVC) is a new video coding scheme that mainly uses the availability of decoder side information to reduce the complexity of the encoder. The quality of the side information has an important influence on the performance of the distributed video coding system. At present, the generation of side information is mainly based on a model that uses inter-frame correlation for motion estimation. In order to make full use of the intra-frame self-similarity of the side information frame, we use the idea of image denoising, and propose an improved side information generation method. Since the initial side information frame can be viewed as a noisy version of the Wyner-Ziv (WZ) frame, improving the side information frame can be translated to denoising the frame. The experimental results show that the quality of the side information obtained by the proposed scheme has been significantly improved, thereby effectively improve the performance of distributed video coding.

articleTitle: Pre Denoising Modulation Recognition Algorithm Based on CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of mismatch of pre trained deep neural network model and sharp deterioration of system performance caused by large difference in SNR between modulation training data and test data, combined with Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks (CycleGAN), a pre denoising modulation recognition algorithm based on CycleGAN was proposed. Low SNR signals learn and imitate the IQ sequence characteristics of high SNR signals to achieve the pre denoising and improve the recognition. Simulation results show that compared with training on modulation training data, the recognition rate of direct test on test data is improved by 28.87%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Channel Characteristics of Underwater Wireless Blue LED Communication System and Outfield Experimental Research
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: One of the key technologies of deep-sea operation is underwater wireless optical communication technology, and blue Light has good penetration ability in water, this paper focuses on analyzing the characteristics of blue light transmission channel in water, and develops a prototype with 4-LED array as the light source. The prototype uses The fresnel lens as the receiving antenna, realizes the design intention of miniaturization while realizing the large FOV (field of view), and conducted a communication experiment in the lake water. The prototype can carry on the stable communication with the BER (bit error rate) as low as 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>in the natural water body with attenuation coefficient of 1.25m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on Handover Technology of Near Space Relay Transmission Link
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Compared with the ground communication system, the communication of the near space vehicle has the advantages of large coverage and long operating distance. However, when the near space vehicle has a long flight distance, the transmission between the near space vehicle and the ground node forms over the horizon transmission, resulting in serious degradation of the communication quality and even communication interruption. In this paper, the relay link handover technology of near space vehicle is studied, the relay model is established, and the relay link handover algorithm is studied from the aspects of handover strategy and handover process. Finally, the handover algorithm proposed in this paper is simulated from three aspects: handover failure probability, total times of initiated handover per unit time and ping-pong performance. The simulation results show that, under the condition of ensuring the communication quality, the handover algorithm proposed in this paper can improve the handover efficiency and handover success rate.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Digital IF Telemetry Receiver
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Aiming at the application environment of telemetry signal reception in flight test, a digital IF telemetry receiver is designed in this paper. ZYNQ solution is adopted to form an independent control center, which greatly reduces the coupling degree and improves the flexibility of the system. This paper studies the architecture of digital IF telemetry receiver, and introduces the demodulation algorithms of PCM-FM and SOQPSK. An implementation scheme of digital IF telemetry receiver is given, simulated and analyzed, the principle prototype is developed, and the flight test is carried out. The test results show that the digital IF receiver has strong adaptability, can adapt to larger bandwidth and meet a variety of telemetry waveform systems. When the waveform is PCM-FM and the bitrate is 20Mbps, the sensitivity can reach −84dBm; When the waveform is SOQPSK and the bit rate is 20Mbps, the sensitivity can reach −84.7dBm. The development of the system provides technical support for mass data telemetry and high-speed data transmission of military type flight test, and has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: A MASH2-2 Sigma Delta Modulator with NTF Zero Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In this paper, a high accuracy discrete-time sigma delta modulator (SDM) is presented. The multistage noise shaping (MASH 2–2) topology which provides a high-order noise shaping while avoiding instabilities is adopted. Unity signal transfer function (STF) which could lower the sensitivity to circuit imperfections is obtained through the feedforward path. Besides, the multibit quantizers are utilized to enhance the dynamic range (DR) and relax the performance requirement of the operational amplifiers. With the purpose of further minimizing the in-band noise power, the zeros of the noise transfer function (NTF) are optimized. A system level simulation based is verified with ideal blocks in SIMSIDES-TOOLBOX. The behavioral model level simulation results show a 14dB SNR improvement with the optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Near Space Relay Transmission Link
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: As a new space for technology and military applications, near space is one of the research hotspots in recent years. Aiming at the problem of over the horizon communication of near space vehicles, the relay transmission link is researched in this paper. According to the time slot of relay transmission signal, three different relay transmission schemes are introduced. At the same time, the three relay transmission schemes are simulated and analyzed under a certain path loss model and power allocation problem. Simulation results show that second scheme proposed in this paper has better bit error rate performance.

articleTitle: Physical-Layer Secure Precoding for UAV Communications with Full-Duplex Jamming
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Although unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are enabling various applications in military, public, and commercial fields, the issue of information security in UAV communications is a critical issue which hinder the extensive applications of the UAVs. To cope with this issue, physical layer security is an alternative security technology, which can enhance the information security by flexibly adjusting transmission strategies and parameters to accommodate the channel changes. In this paper, the information security of the UAV communications is investigated from the perspective of physical layer security. The ground-to-air communications are considered under the presence of eavesdroppers, while the UAV can operate in a full-duplex mode so that it can perform cooperative jamming to confuse the eavesdroppers. The achievable secrecy rate of the UAV networks is maximized by the joint designs of the transmit precoding and cooperative jamming. To this end, an intractable optimization problem is formulated, and a solution scheme is proposed by using the approaches of equivalent transformation and alternating optimization. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves a notable improvement in secrecy rate.

articleTitle: Combining Multi-objective Evolutionary Approach and Machine Learning to Optimize PCI Configuration in Large-scale LTE Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Wireless interference seriously affects the quality of service in mobile communication networks, and PCI planning and optimization is an effective method to reduce interference in 4G and 5G networks. Most of the existing PCI configuration optimization methods focus on solving basic problems, such as PCI collision, PCI confusion and PCI mod 3 interference, which can not meet the complex requirements of actual LTE network optimization. In this paper, we establish six objectives and six constraints based on the PCI optimization requirements of large-scale real LTE networks, and propose a decomposition-based multi-objective evolutionary algorithm combining community detection and reinforcement learning mechanism improvement. Specifically, community detection is used to improve the selection method of crossover segments and mutation points in the evolutionary algorithm so that good sub-region patterns can be inherited to the next generation, and Q-learning method is took to adaptively adjust the crossover and mutation probabilities according to the evolutionary iteration number, population diversity and average fitness to improve the diversity of the population. The PCI optimization results for 1231 optimized cells and 5169 associated cells in a city of China show that our algorithm has improvement in all six objectives with an average 1.38% increase in the optimization rate of the original solution compared to the baseline algorithm, and 21 % reduction in runtime for 1000 generations. Therefore, the proposed algorithm is an effective method to improve PCI configuration and reduce network interference.

articleTitle: Daily Epileptic Seizure Detection Algorithm Based on Multi-modal Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Epilepsy seizure has brought great harm to patients and their families, and generalized tonic-clonic seizure is one of the most dangerous types of epilepsy. It is important in terms of research significance and practical value to detect epilepsy patients' seizures based on wearable devices outside the hospital. In this paper, a wristband is used to simultaneously collect multi-modal physiological signals of epilepsy patients and healthy people under out-of-hospital scenarios. Aiming at the problem of data imbalance, this paper extracts the three-axis continuous noncross ratio feature to eliminate obvious nonseizure data. Then extract features from seizure data of patients and nonseizure data of healthy people and perform feature dimensionality reduction. Finally, a seizure detection model is constructed based on the random forest algorithm. The seizure detection model achieves an average sensitivity of 90% and a false alarm rate of 1.21 times/24h as performing leave one seizure out cross-validation. An average false alarm rate of 1.74 times/24h can be achieved on patients' nonseizure data testing.
